item.title: Rumi Ramen? ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ Cook Up Instant Noodle Collab That You Can Buy Online Now
item.description:
Here's a short and engaging podcast script:
[Intro music]
Host: "Welcome to our show! Today, we're talking about the latest collaboration that's got K-Pop fans and foodies excited. The Netflix animated film KPop Demon Hunters has partnered with South Korean instant noodle company Nongshim to bring you... ramen noodles inspired by the HUNTR/X members!"
[Short music transition]
Host: "That's right! The collection features unique ramen flavors inspired by Rumi, Zoey, and Mira, each with their own signature flavor and colorful cup. And the best part? These noodles are now available in the US, so you can get your hands on them."
[Short sound effects: a ramen noodle packet being opened, a spoon slurping]
Host: "Let's break down the flavors. There's Rumi's 'Superstar' flavor, with a spicy broth and savory ham notes. Then there's Zoey's 'Burger Hero' flavor, with a hamburger-inspired broth and smoky notes. And for those who like it spicy, Mira's 'Spicy Queen' flavor delivers the heat with a bold and savory broth."
[Short music transition]
Host: "These noodles are not only delicious, but they're also easy to prepare. Just microwave or boil water, and you're ready to go. And the best part? They're affordable, with six-packs available on Amazon and Walmart for under $20."
[Outro music]
Host: "So, if you're a K-Pop fan or just a foodie looking to try something new, be sure to check out these KPop Demon Hunters ramen noodles. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you in the next episode!"
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
